title: Giả Định Cách – Luyện Tập
summary: Bài tập và đề thi trắc nghiệm giả định cách.

exercises.question: I wish I _____so much.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'hadn't eaten'.

exercises.question: Had it not been for your help, I ______.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3: 'Had it not been for... , S + would have P2' -> 'would have got lost'.

exercises.question: I wish I ____applied for the job.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had'.

exercises.question: If Margaret hadn’t been wearing a seat belt, she _________injured.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'would have been'.

exercises.question: If the driver in front ________so suddenly, the accident wouldn’t have happened.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'hadn't stopped'.

exercises.question: If you didn’t do this, you ______punished.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: 'would be'.

exercises.question: They helped me a lot. I don’t know what I _______without their help.
exercises.explanation: Giả định quá khứ: 'would have done'.

exercises.question: I wish you _____something instead of just sitting and doing nothing.
exercises.explanation: Mong muốn ai thay đổi hành động ở hiện tại: 'would do'.

exercises.question: I wish Sarah _______here now.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: dùng 'were'.

exercises.question: I wish I ______to the party last night.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ ('last night'): 'had gone'.

exercises.question: She wishes she _____a doctor in the future.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn ở tương lai: 'would be'.

exercises.question: If only _____taller, I might be better at basketball.
exercises.explanation: If only trái ngược hiện tại: 'I were'.

exercises.question: I suggest that he ........... (study).
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'study'.

exercises.question: Is it essential that we ......... (be) there?
exercises.explanation: Giả định với essential: 'be'.

exercises.question: Don recommended that you ........... ( join) the committee.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với recommend: 'join'.

exercises.question: When I stopped talking,Sam finished my sentence for me as though he ..my mind.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với as though trái ngược quá khứ: 'had read'.

exercises.question: It is important that he ...........(try) to study often.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với important: 'try'.

exercises.question: Dr. Smith asked that Mark…(submit) his research paper before the end of the month.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với ask: 'submit'.

exercises.question: Donna requested Frank ............(come) to the party.
exercises.explanation: Donna requested Frank that he come / requested Frank to come. Ở đây 'come' là giả định nguyên thể.

exercises.question: If you……., I would have brought my friends over to your house this evening to watch TV,but I didn’t want to bother you.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3 phủ định: 'hadn't been studying'.

exercises.question: I wish I…….you some money for your rent,but I’m broke myself.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'could lend'.

exercises.question: If it weren’t working for an accounting firm, I….in a bank.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại trộn: 'would be working'.

exercises.question: If there…….the ricefields could have been more productive.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'had been enough water'.

exercises.question: The teacher insists that her students ...........(be) on time.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với insist: 'be'.

exercises.question: Jake recommended that Susan ............ (hire) immediately.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với recommend: 'be hired'.

exercises.question: ……….she agreed, you would have done it.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3: 'Had'.

exercises.question: If he hadn’t wasted too much time , he ……in his examination.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'wouldn't have failed'.

exercises.question: If you had the chance,…….you go fishing?
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: 'would'.

exercises.question: Christine demanded that I ..........(allow) to take part in the negotiations.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với demand: 'be allowed'.

exercises.question: We suggested that you ..............(admit) to the organization.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với suggest: 'be admitted'.

exercises.question: It is important that you ........... (stand) there when he gets off the plane.
exercises.explanation: Giả định tiếp diễn với important: 'be standing'.

exercises.question: I wish ____ his address
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'I knew'.

exercises.question: Would you mind not bringing your dog into the restaurant? -> I'd rather you ________ your dog into the restaurant.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc would rather loại 2 trái ngược hiện tại: 'S1 + would rather + S2 + V.ed/were' -> 'did not bring'.

exercises.question: It is very important that all employees.........in their proper uniforms before 6:30 a.m
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với important: 'be dressed'.

exercises.question: I can't stand him. He always talks as though he ..........everything.
exercises.explanation: As though trái ngược hiện tại: 'knew'.

exercises.question: I enjoyed the movie very much. I wish I___________the book from which it was made.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had read'.

exercises.question: If there were no subjunctive mood, English ............much easier
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: 'would be'.

exercises.question: The coach insisted that Fabio.........the center position.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với insist: 'play'.

exercises.question: The law requires that everyone.........his car checked at least once a month.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với require: 'have' (dùng thể nguyên mẫu 'have' cho S2 'everyone').

exercises.question: We might have failed if you _______us a helping hand.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'had not given'.

exercises.question: “What will you do during winter vacation?” – “I don’t know, but it’s about time______something.”
exercises.explanation: It's about time + S + V.ed -> 'I decided'.

exercises.question: The two strangers talked as if they_______friends for years.
exercises.explanation: As if trái ngược quá khứ: 'had been'.

exercises.question: My suggestion is that the sick boy_______to hospital as soon as possible.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với suggestion: 'be taken'.

exercises.question: The coach wishes the ruby team.........more motivated.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'were'.

exercises.question: if only Judhead.........a little more responsible in his choice of courses!
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'were'.

exercises.question: It's time the children........to bed
exercises.explanation: It's time + S + V.ed -> 'went'.

exercises.question: I suggest that you ...........the tickets in advance
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'book'.

exercises.question: The guard at the gate insisted that everybody_______the rules.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với insist: 'obey'.

exercises.question: I _______her if I thought she would understand.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: 'would tell'.

exercises.question: You are late. If you _______ a few minutes earlier, you_______him.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'had come / would have met'.

exercises.question: I demand that he …………… immediately
exercises.explanation: Giả định với demand: 'apologize'.

exercises.question: It is necessary that everything …………… ready by two o'clock tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với necessary: 'be'.

exercises.question: I like this coat. If it ……………cheaper, I would buy it.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: 'were'.

exercises.question: He insisted that he _______ really very tried and that he _______to have a rest
exercises.explanation: Khẳng định sự thật khách quan ở vế đầu ('was'), vế sau giả định cầu khiến ('be allowed'): 'was / be allowed'.

exercises.question: She didn't come to his birthday party yesterday. He wishes she .…………
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ ('yesterday'): 'had come'.

exercises.question: John behaved as if he.......... himself at the party.
exercises.explanation: As if trái ngược quá khứ: 'had been enjoying'.

exercises.question: It's a pity you missed many lessons. -> I'd rather you.......... so many lessons.
exercises.explanation: Would rather loại 3 trái ngược quá khứ: 'hadn't missed'.

exercises.question: I said that her cooking was terrible. I wish I ………… that.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'hadn't said'.

exercises.question: He likes to swim. He wishes he . ………… near the sea.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'lived'.

exercises.question: It is strange that he ...... so upset about such a trifle, isn't it?
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc giả định 'It is strange that S + should + V.inf': 'should be'.

exercises.question: We should really be working now. -> It's time we ________.
exercises.explanation: It's time + S + V.ed/were (dạng tiếp diễn): 'were working'.

exercises.question: If I …………… you, I would call him.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: 'were'.

exercises.question: It is advisable that you …………… your application as soon as possible.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với advisable: 'submit'.

exercises.question: They disagree on everything and fight all the time. They wish they…… married.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'hadn't got'.

exercises.question: Take an umbrella. It looks as if it …………rain.
exercises.explanation: Trường hợp mô tả hành động có thật sắp xảy ra: 'is going to'.

exercises.question: She described that place as if she ………… it before.
exercises.explanation: As if trái ngược quá khứ: 'had visited'.

exercises.question: It's high time he ………… smoking.
exercises.explanation: It's high time + S + V.ed -> 'stopped'.

exercises.question: If only I ………… how to find her now!
exercises.explanation: If only trái ngược hiện tại: 'knew'.

exercises.question: She suggested that we …………… in the lobby of the hotel at 9:00 a.m.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'should meet' (hoặc 'meet').

exercises.question: If she ____________yesterday, she would come here with us tomorrow night.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện trộn: 'had finished it' (mệnh đề If trái quá khứ 'yesterday', mệnh đề chính trái hiện tại 'tomorrow night').

exercises.question: If I had taken that English course, I____________ much progress.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'would have made'.

exercises.question: They recommend that she …………… to a ski resort in Spain.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với recommend: 'go'.

exercises.question: The doctor insisted that she …………… at the hospital.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với insist: 'stay'.

exercises.question: If I ………… enough money, I could have stayed at a five-star hotel during my vacation.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: 'had had'.

exercises.question: Their trip to China was very interesting. I wish I …………there with them.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had gone'.

exercises.question: She misses him. She wishes he . ………… her a letter
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn ở tương lai: 'would send'.

exercises.question: They treat her as if she ………… their daughter
exercises.explanation: As if trái ngược hiện tại: 'were'.

exercises.question: I cannot sleep. The dog next door is making too much noise. I wish it ______ quiet.
exercises.explanation: Mong muốn thay đổi hành động ở hiện tại: 'would keep'.

exercises.question: She would be disappointed if we ………… her a present.
exercises.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: 'didn't bring'.

exercises.question: He enjoyed talking to them. He wished they ………… so quickly.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had not left'.

exercises.question: I feel sick. I wish I _______ so much cake.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'hadn't eaten'.

exercises.question: Would you like him to paint the door green? -> - I'd rather he ___________ it red.
exercises.explanation: Would rather trái ngược hiện tại: 'painted'.

exercises.question: He recommended that we _________ on time for all meetings.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với recommend: 'be'.

exercises.question: The teacher always _______that the student make an outline before writing a complete essay.
exercises.explanation: Tính từ/động từ cầu khiến 'recommends' đòi hỏi mệnh đề sau dùng giả định: 'recommends that...'.

exercises.question: Alright, Johny, it’s time you _______ to bed.
exercises.explanation: It's time + S + V.ed -> 'went'.

exercises.question: It is recommended that he _______ this course
exercises.explanation: Giả định với recommend: 'take'.

exercises.question: Is it a requirement that the scheme ___________ next Friday?
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với requirement: 'be carried out'.

exercises.question: I suggest that the room _________ before Christmas.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với suggest: 'be decorated'.

exercises.question: The engineers demanded that the worker ____ with them.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với demand: 'go'.

exercises.question: If only the committee ____ the proposal and put them into effect as soon as possible.
exercises.explanation: If only trái ngược hiện tại: 'accepted'.

exercises.question: My advice is that he ____ the city at once.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với advice: 'should leave'.

exercises.question: It’s about time that everybody ____ to do the job.
exercises.explanation: It's about time + S + V.ed -> 'began'.

exercises.question: I would rather all of you _____ at once.
exercises.explanation: Would rather trái ngược hiện tại: 'went'.

exercises.question: Our boss would rather __________ during the working hours.
exercises.explanation: Boss would rather + S + V.ed (trải ngược hiện tại): 'we didn't chat'.

exercises.question: It is important that the police ____ about the case.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với important: 'be informed'.

exercises.question: Fanny insisted that we ____ the day before
exercises.explanation: Fanny khăng khăng khẳng định sự việc đã xảy ra hôm trước (sự thật quá khứ) nên dùng quá khứ hoàn thành: 'had come'.

exercises.question: “Have done something wrong?” “ Wish you _________ more tactful; you’re always offending people”.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'were'.

exercises.question: I wish I _________to him. Now it is too late.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had listened'.

exercises.question: The UN demanded _____ from Vietnamese Eastern waters.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với demand: 'that all Chinese troops be withdrawn'.

exercises.question: The suggestion is that Mary ____ to the club more regularly.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggestion: 'go'.

exercises.question: I can’t understand the French visitors. I wish I ________French.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'knew'.

exercises.question: It is imperative ____ what to do when there is a fire.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với imperative: 'that everyone know'.

exercises.question: It is high time Tom ____ more active in class.
exercises.explanation: It's high time + S + V.ed/were -> 'were'.

exercises.question: We suggest that she ____ the 10.30 train immediately.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'take'.

exercises.question: The doctor recommended that the patient ________as soon as possible.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với recommend: 'be operated'.

exercises.question: It is imperative that your facebook password ________ confidential.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với imperative: 'needs to be kept'.

exercises.question: I recommended that she ___________ reduce her expenditure.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với recommend: 'should'.

exercises.question: She acted as if she_______ big amount of money.
exercises.explanation: As if trái ngược hiện tại: 'had'.

exercises.question: A: These figures are too complicated to work out in your head. -> B: Yes, _________ a calculator.
exercises.explanation: If only trái ngược hiện tại: 'if only we had'.

exercises.question: It’s high time the children _________ their lesson. They are watching TV now.
exercises.explanation: It's high time + S + V.ed -> 'prepared'.

exercises.question: I’m really sleepy today. I wish I _______ Bob to the airport late last night.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ ('last night'): 'hadn't had to take' (ước giá như tôi đã không phải đưa Bob ra sân bay).

exercises.question: I’d rather you _______ to the English-speaking club with me this Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Would rather trái ngược hiện tại: 'came'.

exercises.question: It has been suggested that Mary_a computer course in preparation for a steady job.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'take'.

exercises.question: I’d rather you ________ home now.
exercises.explanation: Would rather trái ngược hiện tại: 'went'.

exercises.question: It’s important that she __________ at once.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với important: 'should leave'.

exercises.question: If only it _________ raining.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn ở tương lai/hiện tại thể hiện mong mỏi: 'would stop'.

exercises.question: The doctor suggested that his patient _________ smoking
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'stop'.

exercises.question: Christine demanded that I __________ to take part in the negotiations.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với demand: 'be allowed'.

exercises.question: We suggested that you ______ to the organization.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với suggest: 'be admitted'.

exercises.question: It’s important that you _________ there when he gets off the plane.
exercises.explanation: Giả định tiếp diễn với important: 'be standing'.

exercises.question: Jane would rather it _________winter now.
exercises.explanation: Would rather trái ngược hiện tại: 'were'.

exercises.question: The director requests that all packages ______ at the central office.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với request: 'be sent'.

exercises.question: It is essential that she ________ the truth about her illness.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với essential: 'be told'.

exercises.question: Dan’s parents insist that he _____ home every week.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với insist: 'call'.

exercises.question: “What is your opinion?” – “It is necessary that an employee ……………….his work on time”
exercises.explanation: Giả định với necessary: 'finish'.

exercises.question: “What instructions did your boss give you?” – “He requires that Alice ________ the meeting”
exercises.explanation: Giả định với require: 'attend'.

exercises.question: It was urgent that she __________ the robbery to the police immediately.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với urgent: 'report'.

exercises.question: The teacher demanded that Tom ___________ the room.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với demand: 'leave'.

exercises.question: The boys proposed that their group leader ______ a camping trip.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với propose: 'organize'.

exercises.question: It’s high time they ______ this road.
exercises.explanation: It's high time + S + V.ed -> 'mended'.

exercises.question: Tom acts as if he _________ my boss.
exercises.explanation: As if trái ngược hiện tại: 'were'.

exercises.question: The boss insisted that Sam …………….at the meeting.
exercises.explanation: Giả định phủ định với insist: 'not be'.

exercises.question: He treats us as if we _________ all idiots.
exercises.explanation: As if trái ngược hiện tại: 'were'.

exercises.question: I’d rather you ______ by train.
exercises.explanation: Would rather trái ngược hiện tại: 'went'.

exercises.question: It has been suggested that income tax __________
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với suggest: 'be abolished'.

exercises.question: - I wish you _____ making that noise. It's bothering me. -Sorry, I'll stop it right now.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn thể hiện mong mỏi thay đổi hành động ở hiện tại: 'would stop'.

exercises.question: - I told your mother that you had left your job. -Well, I wish you _____ her. It's none of your business.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'hadn't told'.

exercises.question: I demand that I __________ to be free now.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với demand: 'be allowed'.

exercises.question: They moved that their plan ____ rejected.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với move (đề nghị): 'be'.

exercises.question: The doctor suggested that Tom _____ smoking.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'stop'.

exercises.question: It’s a little difficult to find the restaurant. I propose that we all ____________ together so that nobody gets lost along the way.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với propose: 'drive'.

exercises.question: It is important that Henry ___________very differently from you. She may not agree to the changes you have made in the organization of the company
exercises.explanation: Giả định với important: 'think'.

exercises.question: Was it really necessary that I _____ there watching you the entire time you were rehearsing for the play? It was really boring watching you repeat the scenes over and over again.
exercises.explanation: Giả định tiếp diễn với necessary: 'be sitting'.

exercises.question: Tom asked that we _________ her graduation ceremony next week.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với ask: 'attend'.

exercises.question: I am not going to sit here and let her insult me. I demand that she immediately ______________ for what she just said.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với demand: 'apologize'.

exercises.question: The monk insisted that the tourists___ the temple until they had removed their shoes.
exercises.explanation: Giả định phủ định với insist: 'not enter'.

exercises.question: It’s vital that the United States _____ on improving its public education system. What we do now will affect our country for generations to come.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với vital: 'focus'.

exercises.question: I suggest that John_______________ the directions carefully before assembling the bicycle. He doesn’t want the wheels to fall off while he is riding down a hill.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggest: 'read'.

exercises.question: It is absolutely necessary _ in the library by 5.00 PM if we want sufficient time for the test.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với necessary: 'that we be'.

exercises.question: I really enjoyed our trip to the theatre. I wish we _____ more often
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại/mong mỏi thói quen: 'went'.

exercises.question: - My feet are killing me! I wish I _____ more comfortable shoes. -Yeah, me too. I wish I _____ that we were going to have to walk this much.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had worn/ knew'.

exercises.question: It was critical that the paramedics ______ within 5 minutes of the traffic collision.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với critical: 'arrive'.

exercises.question: It is important that we _________ for all possible emergencies.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với important: 'be prepared'.

exercises.question: His girlfriend insists ___________

options.text: that he doesn’t date other women
he must not date other women
that he not date other women

exercises.explanation: Giả định phủ định với insist: 'that he not date other women'.

exercises.question: - Did you study for that test? . - No, but now I wish I _____ because I flunked it.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had studied'.

exercises.question: - It's raining. I wish it _____ -Me too. If only the sun _____ so that we could go swimming.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn và giả định hiện tại: 'would stop/ were shining'.

exercises.question: Our proposal is that he ______ to group leader.
exercises.explanation: Giả định bị động với proposal: 'be elected'.

exercises.question: The doctor’s suggestion is that she ______a holiday.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggestion: 'take'.

exercises.question: We recommend that he ______ with us.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với recommend: 'should go'.

exercises.question: - Are we lost? - I think so. I wish we _____ a map with us today.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'had brought'.

exercises.question: -Could you lend me some money? - I wish I _____ you some money for your rent, but I'm broke myself
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược hiện tại: 'could lend'.

exercises.question: The teacher asked that all students _________ on time for the next test.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với ask: 'should be'.

exercises.question: The coach advised that the students______ in the race.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với advise: 'complete'.

exercises.question: The teacher required that we _____ our work before 6 p.m
exercises.explanation: Giả định với require: 'A & C are correct' ('finish' hoặc 'should finish').

exercises.question: His suggestion _________ to see the art exhibition interested every one of us.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggestion: 'that we go'.

exercises.question: She wishes she _________ you the bad news yesterday.
exercises.explanation: Ước muốn trái ngược quá khứ: 'hadn't told'.

exercises.question: The teacher recommended that Tom _________ his composition as soon as possible
exercises.explanation: Giả định với recommend: 'finish writing'.

exercises.question: It’s essential that every student ________ the exam before attending the course.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với essential: 'pass'.

exercises.question: If only I ________ you wanted to invest money in business.
exercises.explanation: If only trái ngược quá khứ: 'had known'.

exercises.question: I don’t like the suggestion that we ______ this job together.
exercises.explanation: Giả định với suggestion: 'do'.
